Callout.Name: Stolen Plates Reported
Callout.Message: Plates reported stolen from a parked car.

Script.Line: Both plates were taken in the night and both were left on the ground.
I did not hear anything. Not a thing.
It is a clean removal. That is what they do now.

Lines.Approach: Somebody has had their plates off in a car park. They will be on something soon.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
